description: Java source code for RssContentProvider, an Android ContentProvider implementation managing RSS feed data stored in an SQLite database.

classes.name: RssContentProvider
classes.description: Android ContentProvider for managing RSS feed items stored in an SQLite database, including CRUD operations and URI matching.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: Inner class extending ContentProviderDatabaseHelper, responsible for creating and upgrading the RSS items database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the database connection when the ContentProvider is created.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for the given URI, distinguishing between list and single item.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a database query based on the URI and parameters, returning a Cursor.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates database records matching the URI and ContentValues.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the database and returns its URI.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes records matching the URI and returns the count.
